title: Softmax, cross-entropy, and the output-layer gradient

questions.text: Why subtract max(z) before exponentiating in softmax?

options.b: numerical stability — to avoid overflow of exp on large logits

questions.text: With a one-hot target y and p = softmax(logits), the gradient of cross-entropy with respect to the logits is:
